capabilities.humanEntrypoint: Read the record index and selected detail.
capabilities.resultSummary: Return all evidence records, the selected record, annotations, and revision.
capabilities.userJourney: Inspect all sample records, their evidence states, the selected record, annotations, and revision.

capabilities.humanEntrypoint: Activate a record in the evidence index.

expectedRevision.description: Desk revision observed immediately before selection.

recordId.description: Identifier of the record to select.

capabilities.resultSummary: Return the selected record identity, unchanged evidence state, and committed revision.
capabilities.userJourney: Make one named evidence record the shared visible selection.
capabilities.visibleEffect: The bounded detail region displays the selected record and its unchanged evidence state.

capabilities.humanEntrypoint: Submit the labelled annotation form for the selected record.

expectedRevision.description: Desk revision observed immediately before annotation.

note.description: Factual annotation to attach to the record.

recordId.description: Identifier of the evidence record to annotate.

capabilities.resultSummary: Return the record identity, saved annotation, unchanged evidence state, annotation count, and committed revision.
capabilities.userJourney: Attach one factual note to a named record without promoting or resolving its evidence state.
capabilities.visibleEffect: The note appears under the selected record and the revision advances; the record status does not change.
